_note: Support items (src/combat/SupportItems.js, docs/GAMEPLAY_PLAN.md §5). items: what each role carries (the item key, 3; supply pods, depots and redeploying refill them). stim: the teammate you face within reach (else yourself, if hurt) heals `heal` over `over` s; a downed one is up `reviveTime` s later with `reviveHp` of his health. ammo: a pack dropped at your feet; teammates short of at least a mag take `mags` each as they pass (`takers` of them, for `life` s). repair: engineers hold the dig key (H) beside a damaged friendly vehicle or turret: `rate` HP a second. cooldown: s between uses of an item.
